reportTakeaways: The Nifty 50 ended the week 2.00% higher; the Nifty Next 50 gained 2.86%, the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 2.69% and the Nifty Smallcap 100 gained 4.08%.
Sectors up over the week: Pharma, Healthcare, Media, Realty, Metal, Auto, FMCG, PSU banks, IT, Consumer durables, Private banks, Energy.
body: What moved | The Nifty 50 closed the week at 23,053.10, up 2.00% from the previous week's close of 22,600.00 on 23 Oct, and rose 0.51% on the day. Over the week the Nifty Next 50 gained 2.86%, the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 2.69% and the Nifty Smallcap 100 gained 4.08%.
Breadth | On the day 378 stocks in the Nifty 500 fell and 121 rose, according to NSE. India VIX, which measures the volatility traders expect, rose 2.21% to 15.45.
Sectors | Over the week Pharma did best (+7.09%) and Cement worst (−1.79%) among the sector indices in the heatmap.
